summary_md: **AgentsWatch ([@AgentsWatch](https://x.com/AgentsWatch/status/2116073657776967974))** covers Qiu et al.'s *MAServeBench* ([arXiv 2610.40293](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40293)), which treats multi-agent collaboration as a serving workload: dependency-aware release hit 100% deadline attainment versus 4% for barrier ordering at a fixed workload; a follow-up clarifies these are medians at moderate load and both fail at high load.
